about: Coordinates are web-game scene px: x right, y DOWN, the 800×600 safe area spans x 0..800 (bleed to -300 and 1100). In Unity: position = (x / 100, -y / 100). `placed` is every sprite exactly as the web game draws it, in draw order (back to front) — anchor point, scale (already includes the size chart), flip. `layout` is the data the web game builds the scene from (grid coordinates), to rebuild or edit it in Unity.
